overview_description.description: AYDO is a blockchain and AI-powered platform focused on connecting IoT devices to decentralized physical infrastructure networks (DePIN). The company enables users and businesses to monetize data from third-party sensors and smart devices by streaming it into decentralized ecosystems, helping reduce hardware costs while expanding scalable AI and data infrastructure.
